representation.surface: natural MANO-R surface kept separate from L20 mesh
representation.functional_skeleton: all non-wrist semantic points in independent palm-normalized frames plus bone bend angles

optimizer.objective: semantic point alignment + bone directions + bend angles + task pair + q smoothness
optimizer.q_space: 16 independent L20 q; 5 mimic joints expanded by URDF

limitations: The sequence is synthetic interpolation of three fixed MANO poses, not camera data.
This aligns a functional skeleton, not every human and CAD surface vertex.
Collision/contact and actuator u are not active; the current collision meshes have unfiltered overlaps.
